# nylo_support

**Tag**: micro-framework, framework, ui, tooling

## 简介

Support library for the Nylo framework. This library supports routing, widgets, localization, cli, storage and more.

## 官网

- 主页: https://nylo.dev
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/nylo-core/support/tree/7.x
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/nylo-core/support/issues
- 文档: https://github.com/nylo-core/support
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/nylo_support
